# FulcrumGrid

> FulcrumGrid is a family of purpose-built business apps for small and mid-sized businesses — Command Center (real-time operations dashboard), Collection (accounts receivable and payments), and HR Suite (people operations) — plus custom business apps built on the same secure, auditable platform. The apps share one consistent experience; you can start with one and add more as you grow. FulcrumGrid is fully bilingual (English and Arabic/RTL) and is built by Avenlor Consulting. Contact: contact@avenlorconsulting.com.

Key facts:
- Available now: Command Center, Collection, HR Suite.
- On the roadmap: Inventory, CRM, Analytics, Procurement.
- Custom apps: tailored business apps built for a specific workflow, on the same platform.
- Approach: role-based access, full audit trail, exportable data, one consistent design across every app.
- Pricing: per-user, per-month plans (Starter, Business, Enterprise) with a free trial; see the pricing page.
- Languages: English and Arabic.
- Website: https://fulcrumgrid.com

## Products
- [Products overview](https://fulcrumgrid.com/products/): The full family of FulcrumGrid business apps.
- [Command Center](https://fulcrumgrid.com/products/command-center/): Real-time operations dashboard — live KPIs, alerts, automated workflows, reporting.
- [Collection](https://fulcrumgrid.com/products/collection/): Accounts receivable and payments — invoice tracking, automated reminders, payment reconciliation.
- [HR Suite](https://fulcrumgrid.com/products/hr-suite/): People operations — employee records, onboarding, payroll, time off, performance reviews.
- [Custom business apps](https://fulcrumgrid.com/custom-apps/): Custom apps tailored to a specific workflow, built on the FulcrumGrid platform.
- [Coming soon](https://fulcrumgrid.com/products/coming-soon/): Inventory, CRM, Analytics, and Procurement.
